title: 四格视频成果（背景干净版）

complete_video_analysis.limitations: Automatic timing may use embedded media clocks; check against real source duration. Catalog labels may be mismatched; prefer actual preview when verified.

scenes.audio: Upbeat, energetic electronic synth music starts with a fast-paced tempo.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A young 3D-animated male character with black hair and glasses is shown from behind, sitting at a white desk. He is holding a blue and white card with icons of a soundwave, a video reel, and an image. He is looking at a computer monitor displaying a blue audio waveform. The room is brightly lit with soft, even artificial light. The background is a blurred light-blue and white wall.

scenes.audio: Continued upbeat synth music; a faint 'glitch' sound effect.
scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.visual: The same male character is seated next to a young female character with wavy red hair and a green shirt. The male character has his hands on his head with a frustrated expression. The female character looks concerned with her hand on her chin. They are in a well-lit indoor setting with a plain beige background and a white table in front of them.

scenes.audio: A digital 'ding' sound effect as the card touches the table.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A first-person view of the male character's hands placing a card on a white desk next to a white keyboard. The card has a purple icon representing 'FredTalk AI' (a stylized brain/sound icon). The lighting is bright and soft.

scenes.audio: Upbeat music continues at a steady volume.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The male and female characters from Scene 2 are at the white table. The male character is pointing toward the camera with a confident smile. The female character watches him with an interested expression. The lighting is soft and warm.

scenes.audio: A soft 'pop' sound as the thought bubble appears.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Close-up of the male character's face. He is wearing black-rimmed glasses and has a thought bubble appearing next to his head. Inside the bubble is an illustration of a small blue house with a red roof and a plus symbol. He has a hopeful, imaginative expression.

scenes.audio: Rapid typing sound effects layered over the music.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Over-the-shoulder shot of the male character sitting at the computer. The screen shows a gallery of images and a video being processed with a green checkmark. His hands are on the keyboard, typing rapidly. The lighting is focused on the desk surface.

scenes.audio: The sound of a marker squeaking on paper.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: A first-person view of a hand holding a black marker, drawing a simple house shape (a square with a triangle on top) on a white piece of paper. The lines are blue. The lighting is bright and clear.

scenes.audio: A cheerful chime sound effect.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The female character is smiling and holding a physical 3D model of the blue house with a red roof. She is showing it to the male character, whose back is to the camera. They are in a brightly lit studio or workshop environment.

scenes.audio: A camera shutter sound effect.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: A hand holds a physical ID card featuring the male character's face against a purple amusement park background. The background is a blurred theme park with a Ferris wheel. The card is held steady in the center of the frame.

scenes.audio: A low-volume 'wow' vocalization.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: Close-up of the male character's face as he looks at his computer screen. He has a wide, joyous smile and wide eyes, appearing impressed. The screen's light reflects slightly on his glasses.

scenes.audio: Marker squeaking sound continues.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: The hand continues drawing on the paper, adding a small circular window with a cross to the blue house sketch. The movement is steady and precise.

scenes.audio: The sound of a small hammer tapping or tools clinking.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: The male character is in a workshop with an older man with grey hair and a blue apron. They are looking at the 3D house model on a workbench filled with tools like screwdrivers and pliers. The older man is adjusting the model while the boy watches intently.

scenes.audio: A soft 'click' sound effect.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: A close-up of the male character's hand holding a small card with the same soundwave/video icons toward a similar card on a table. The background shows multiple other blue and purple cards. The lighting is soft and top-down.

scenes.audio: Marker squeak ends with a sharp 'click' as the cap is put on.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: The hand finishes the drawing of the house by adding a circular detail. The paper is white and the marker is blue. The shot is stable and top-down.

scenes.audio: A satisfying plastic 'click' or 'snap' sound.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: A close-up of a hand pressing down on the roof of the physical 3D house model. The model is on a light-colored wooden surface. The focus is sharp on the fingers and the red texture of the roof.

scenes.audio: Ambient theme park sounds: distant laughter and carousel music.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: The male character is at an amusement park entrance gate. He is handing his ID card (from Scene 9) to a female staff member wearing a grey vest and a white shirt. In the background, a carousel and Ferris wheel are visible. The lighting is bright and natural-looking.

scenes.audio: Fast-paced shuffling sound effects.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: The male character's hands are arranging four different cards on a desk: one with a soundwave, one with a video reel, one with an image icon, and one with the 'FredTalk AI' logo. The cards are blue and purple.

scenes.audio: Sound of light clapping and a cheerful melody.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The male character holds up his finished drawing of the house while the female character looks on with a happy, clapping gesture. They both look proud and satisfied. The background is the same beige room from Scene 2.

scenes.audio: A 'sparkle' sound effect.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: Close-up of the male character's hand pointing at the 3D model house he is holding. The red roof and blue walls of the house are clearly visible. The focus is on the interaction between his hand and the model.

scenes.audio: A digital 'beep' of a successful scan; the music swells and then ends on a final chord.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: The female staff member at the amusement park gate scans the male character's ID card with a handheld device. She smiles warmly at him. The background remains the colorful amusement park with bright daylight.
